metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Beijing, Chongqing, and Wuhan all decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in three Chinese cities (Beijing, Chongqing, and Wuhan) during two time periods in 2020. I need to: 1. Use Sentinel-5P data which provides tropospheric NO2 measurements 2. Compare February 10-25, 2020 vs January 1-20, 2020 3. Check if ALL three cities show decreased NO2 levels For data quality: - Use Sentinel-5P 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2' collection - Band: 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' - Need to check collection sizes for both periods - Check valid pixel counts after processing - Validate the NO2 values are reasonable (not negative or extremely high) I'll compute mean NO2 for each city in each period, then check if all three cities show a decrease from Jan to Feb. For geometry, I'll use points for the three cities with appropriate buffers. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define cities as points with buffers const beijing = ee.Geometry.Point([116.4074, 39.9042]).buffer(20000); const chongqing = ee.Geometry.Point([106.5516, 29.5630]).buffer(20000); const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point([114.2734, 30.5833]).buffer(20000); const cities = [ {name: 'Beijing', geom: beijing}, {name: 'Chongqing', geom: chongqing}, {name: 'Wuhan', geom: wuhan} ]; // Time periods const janPeriod = ['2020-01-01', '2020-01-20']; const febPeriod = ['2020-02-10', '2020-02-25']; // Sentinel-5P NO2 collection const no2Collection = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2'; const no2Band = 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'; const results = []; for (const city of cities) { // Get collections for both periods const janCol = ee.ImageCollection(no2Collection) .filterDate(janPeriod[0], janPeriod[1]) .filterBounds(city.geom) .select(no2Band); const febCol = ee.ImageCollection(no2Collection) .filterDate(febPeriod[0], febPeriod[1]) .filterBounds(city.geom) .select(no2Band); const janSize = janCol.size().getInfo(); const febSize = febCol.size().getInfo(); // Check for empty collections if (janSize === 0 || febSize === 0) { console.log(`${city.name}: Empty collection (Jan: ${janSize}, Feb: ${febSize})`); console.log('C1'); return; } // Compute mean NO2 for each period const janMean = janCol.mean(); const febMean = febCol.mean(); // Get pixel counts and values const janStats = janMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: city.geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const febStats = febMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: city.geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const janValue = janStats[no2Band + '_mean']; const febValue = febStats[no2Band + '_mean']; const janCount = janStats[no2Band + '_count']; const febCount = febStats[no2Band + '_count']; // Check for no valid pixels if (janCount === 0 || febCount === 0) { console.log(`${city.name}: No valid pixels (Jan: ${janCount}, Feb: ${febCount})`); console.log('C2'); return; } // Validate values are reasonable (NO2 should be positive and typically < 1e-4 mol/m²) if (janValue === null || febValue === null || janValue < 0 || febValue < 0 || janValue > 1e-3 || febValue > 1e-3) { console.log(`${city.name}: Invalid values (Jan: ${janValue}, Feb: ${febValue})`); console.log('C3'); return; } results.push({ name: city.name, janValue: janValue, febValue: febValue, decreased: febValue < janValue }); console.log(`${city.name}: Jan ${janValue.toExponential(2)} (px:${janCount}), Feb ${febValue.toExponential(2)} (px:${febCount})`); } // Check if all cities show decrease const allDecreased = results.every(r => r.decreased); console.log(`All decreased: ${allDecreased}`); if (allDecreased) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```

Chongqing: Jan 1.67e-4 (px:1509), Feb 6.59e-5 (px:1509)
Wuhan: Jan 1.53e-4 (px:1523), Feb 7.24e-5 (px:1523)
